newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan-concerned by balanced budget amendment.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan-concerned by balanced budget amendment.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan voiced concerns on Tuesday about a proposed balanced budget amendment to the constituion.
"I still have concerns," he told the Senate Banking Committee.

But he admitted that "artificial" restraints on the budget -- such as those inherent in a balanced budget amendment -- have worked surprisingly well in the past in bringing down the deficit. In particular, he pointed to the caps on discretionary government spending already enacted by Congress and said he had been surprised by how well they had worked.
